ne51dafe7ce.headline: Oil prices spike on vaccine hopes, EU deal
ne51dafe7ce.summary: Oil prices increased following a deal among European Union leaders and encouraging early vaccine data.
ne51dafe7ce.why: Oil prices are sensitive to geopolitical developments and economic recovery prospects, with vaccine progress signaling potential demand growth.

n26e50af09e.headline: Czech politicians welcomed the EU recovery fund agreement, criticize Babiš's negotiations
n26e50af09e.summary: Czech politicians mostly support the EU financial aid agreement for coronavirus-affected countries, though some criticize potential burdens on future generations.
n26e50af09e.why: The EU recovery fund is a major fiscal stimulus aimed at mitigating economic damage from the pandemic, affecting member states' economies and fiscal policies.
